field_notes.units: Keyed by codename (the unit file name and UnitDefs key).
field_notes.name: English display name from language/en/units.json (customparams.i18nfromunit is followed).
field_notes.tech_level: customparams.techlevel; alldefs_post.lua sets 1 when absent. 1.5 marks T1.5 units.
field_notes.cost: metal = metalcost, energy = energycost, buildtime = buildtime (the build power cost: seconds to build with 1 build power).
field_notes.builder.can_build: Engine builder flag (builder and workertime > 0) and at least one build option.
field_notes.builder.can_assist/can_repair/can_reclai: Engine defaults to the builder flag; the def can override. Repair and reclaim also need repairspeed/reclaimspeed > 0 (default workertime).
field_notes.builder.can_resurrect: canresurrect defaults to false, and resurrectspeed (default workertime) must be > 0.
field_notes.stealth: radar stealth (stealth); sonar_stealth is listed separately.
field_notes.cloak: cost_static = cloakcost and cost_moving = cloakcostmoving (default cloakcost), both energy per second; decloak_range = mincloakdistance (elmos). can_cloak defaults to cloakcost != 0.
field_notes.sensors: Radii in elmos. air_los defaults to 1.5 x los (engine).
field_notes.movement: null for units that cannot move. move_type is ground, hover_air (aircraft that build, transport or have hoverattack, i.e. gunships: they steer by turn_rate at all times) or strafe_air (fighters, bombers and scouts: the engine ignores turnrate and steers them by turn_radius, in elmos; default 500, doubled for bombers). speed is elmos/s. acceleration and brake are the def values in elmos/frame^2 (engine unit) with elmos/s^2 conversions; strafe_air units with a weapon default to 0.065. turn_rate is heading units (65536 per turn) per frame and turn_rate_deg_s converts it; both are null for strafe_air, and turn_radius is null otherwise.
field_notes.size: radius is the circle with the same area as the unit's XZ outline (height ignored): from the collision volume when the def sets one, otherwise from the footprint (16 elmos per square).
field_notes.wreck: null when the unit leaves no corpse. metal, energy and health are the corpse's (the wreck); chain lists the corpse then what it decays into (usually the heap) with each one's metal, energy, health, reclaimable and resurrectable. alldefs_post.lua sets non-commander dead/heap health to the unit's health and metal to floor(metalcost x 0.6) / floor(metalcost x 0.25); commanders keep their file values. resurrectable follows the engine: feature resurrectable -1 (default) means only the unit's own corpse.
field_notes.weapons: One entry per weapons[] mount, in mount order. Death explosions and weapon defs that no mount uses are left out.
field_notes.weapons[].reload_s: reloadtime rounded down to whole frames, as alldefs_post.lua does.
field_notes.weapons[].aoe: radius = areaofeffect / 2 (the def value is a diameter). Engine falloff at distance d from the target's surface: (R - d) / (R - d * edge). half_damage_radius is where that reaches 0.5, R / (2 - edge). effective_radius is the radius of a full-damage disc that deals the same total area damage. impact_only weapons have no splash. BeamLasers with impactonly are rewritten by alldefs_post.lua to areaofeffect 11 and edge 1.
field_notes.weapons[].vs: Per target type (land = ground and surface-water units, air = aircraft, sub = submarines). damage is per projectile hit, read from damage.<armor> with damage.default as fallback (land: default, air: vtol, sub: subs). salvo = damage x burst x projectiles. dps = salvo / reload_s. range is the weapon range (null when it cannot target that type). can_target uses onlytargetcategory, and sub also needs waterweapon (engine: non-water weapons cannot hit underwater targets from above water).
field_notes.weapons[].arc: Mount aim limits from weapons[].maindir and maxangledif (default 360 = no limit). Angles in degrees relative to the unit's front, positive towards the unit's left (x+). Scripts may limit aim further.
field_notes.weapons[].turret_turn: Present when the weapon has turret = true. yaw_deg_s and pitch_deg_s come from the unit script's AimWeapon function (COB turn speed <x> is degrees per second; accelerated turrets use MAX_AIMY<n>_VELOCITY x 30). method 'unresolved' means the script computes the speed in a way this reader does not follow.
field_notes.combat: dps is the sum of weapons[].vs.<type>.dps over mounts that fire on their own (excludes manual-fire, stockpiled, interceptor, shield, bogus and zero-damage mounts). max_range is the longest of those mounts' ranges per type. dps_by_range lists one band per distinct range, longest first, with that band's dps, the mounts in it, and cumulative_dps: the DPS of every counted mount that reaches that distance.
field_notes.summary: One-line plain-text description for search/RAG indexing.
